description: Branch session-end maintenance: revive memory + maybe generate an authored skill.

steps.description: Clean agent MEMORY.md files, promote real facts, write memory_summary.md

steps.command: node -e "import('./dist/memory/session-metrics-tracker.js').then(m => { const env = m.currentSessionMetricsEnv(); process.env.SESSION_METRICS = env; return import('./dist/skills/session-skill-generator.js'); }).then(sg => sg.maybeGenerateFromSessionEnd(JSON.parse(process.env.SESSION_METRICS || '{}')))"
steps.description: Load real SESSION_METRICS from the tracker, then distill a complex session into an authored- skill

notes: SESSION_METRICS is now filled by session-metrics-tracker at session end. Both steps are safe to re-run.
